remarks: Situated on one of Rowayton's most coveted private streets within the Rowayton Beach Association (RBA), this custom-designed home embodies the very best of seaside living. Just steps from the private beach and a short stroll to the charming downtown village, the residence blends relaxed luxury with exceptional craftsmanship, featuring impeccable finishes, stonework, and timeless detail.  The heart of the home is a sun-filled great room with soaring ceilings and antique beams, seamlessly integrating a gourmet kitchen, dining, and living areas. The chef's kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, including dual 30" Sub-Zero refrigerators, a 48" Wolf range/oven, and a walk-in pantry. French doors line the main living spaces, opening to a spacious slate terrace with a built-in reading/daybed nook and heated ceiling lamps perfect for year-round indoor-outdoor living.  With 4 bedrooms, 2 dedicated offices, and a versatile open floor plan, this home accommodates both work and leisure. Highlights include radiant-heated floors, extensive built-ins, a state-of-the-art sound system, whole-house generator, a fully equipped gym, and a beautifully designed office/au pair suite or family room. The serene primary suite offers a spa-inspired bath, generous walk-in closet, and a private third-floor yoga/meditation room with French doors overlooking Long Island Sound.
